description: Canonical machine-readable projection of the redactable content-carrier slots listed in zh/models/event-and-patch.md section 4.2.4. One row registers one slot path on one object kind. An ak.schema.patch.v1 $op="unset" that addresses a registered path MUST be rejected with schema_violation reason=patch_unset_redactable_field; $op="set" on the same path is ordinary authoring and MUST be accepted, including when the new value carries an empty body. Realm-defined fields marked redactable: true are governed by the same rule and are declared by their own Realm schema, never by this registry.
registry_rules: A redactable content-carrier slot is a field that carries an object's authored body. Its absence on the materialized object is reserved for exactly two causes: the body was never authored, or it was cleared by redaction. message.schema.json already encodes that reservation (state=active requires exactly one of content / encrypted_content, state=redacted forbids both), so an ordinary ak.<kind>.update MUST NOT create a third cause and $op="unset" on a registered path is rejected.

The plaintext and encrypted forms of one slot are registered as two rows bound by paired_path, and the binding MUST be symmetric. Both rows carry the same decision, so whether a body can be removed never depends on whether the Realm is end-to-end encrypted.

This registry is not a capability boundary and MUST NOT be read as one. Redaction is whole-object, terminal, audit-committed, and additionally invalidates history, search indexes, local caches and Blob access; no patch op can produce that effect, so no patch op can escape it. A $op="set" that overwrites a registered slot with an empty body is ordinary authoring, not an unaudited redaction.

Every row MUST declare a non_terminal_clear_op other than unset plus the terminal_clear_event_kinds that remove the slot entirely. Registering a slot therefore can never turn a field into a write-once field: there is always a documented way to empty it while the object stays active.

Fields that are not content-carrier slots MUST NOT be registered here. metadata, encrypted_metadata, metadata.title, metadata.summary and every path under metadata.fields are ordinary optional members whose non-terminal clear path is $op="unset", subject only to post-state object schema validation.

redactable_fields.non_terminal_clear_contract: Set the slot to a ContentBlock whose body is empty, for example {"kind":"ak.content.text","body":""}. The slot stays present and the Message stays state=active.
redactable_fields.description: Message body, plaintext form. Exclusive with encrypted_content; required while state=active and forbidden once state=redacted.

redactable_fields.non_terminal_clear_contract: Re-authority commit a ContentBlock whose body is empty and set the resulting EncryptedPayload on the slot. The slot stays present and the Message stays state=active.
redactable_fields.description: Message body, encrypted form. Exclusive with content; required while state=active and forbidden once state=redacted.

redactable_fields.non_terminal_clear_contract: Set the slot to a ContentBlock whose body is empty, for example {"kind":"ak.content.text","body":""}. The slot stays present and the Strand stays state=active.
redactable_fields.description: Strand Description body, plaintext form. Exclusive with encrypted_content and independent of every track.

redactable_fields.non_terminal_clear_contract: Re-authority commit a ContentBlock whose body is empty and set the resulting EncryptedPayload on the slot. The slot stays present and the Strand stays state=active.
redactable_fields.description: Strand Description body, encrypted form. Exclusive with content and independent of every track.

redactable_fields.non_terminal_clear_contract: Set the slot to a ContentBlock whose body is empty, for example {"kind":"ak.content.text","body":""}. The slot stays present, the Strand stays state=active, and tracks.synthesis must remain active.
redactable_fields.description: Synthesis track body, plaintext form. Exclusive with tracks.synthesis.encrypted_content and writable only while the track is active.

redactable_fields.non_terminal_clear_contract: Re-authority commit a ContentBlock whose body is empty and set the resulting EncryptedPayload on the slot. The slot stays present, the Strand stays state=active, and tracks.synthesis must remain active.
redactable_fields.description: Synthesis track body, encrypted form. Exclusive with tracks.synthesis.content and writable only while the track is active.

redactable_fields.non_terminal_clear_contract: Set the slot to a ContentBlock whose body is empty, for example {"kind":"ak.content.text","body":""}. The slot stays present and the Morph stays state=active.
redactable_fields.description: Morph body, plaintext form. Exclusive with encrypted_content.

redactable_fields.non_terminal_clear_contract: Re-authority commit a ContentBlock whose body is empty and set the resulting EncryptedPayload on the slot. The slot stays present and the Morph stays state=active.
redactable_fields.description: Morph body, encrypted form. Exclusive with content.
